items.name: AWS Activate
items.amount_note: Up to USD 200,000 in AWS Activate credits, with additional credits for AI startups (page).
items.regions: not restricted on the page fetched

items.name: Africa Business Heroes (ABH) Prize
items.amount_note: Ten finalists share USD 1.5 million in grant funding; the top winner receives up to USD 300,000 (homepage).
items.deadline_text: annual: the 2026 application deadline was 7 May 2026
items.stages: established: registered business or 3+ years of proven operation
items.eligibility: African entrepreneurs. The 2026 application required proof of legal registration or proof of operation for 3+ years (bank statements and similar). Read the current application guidelines each year.
items.notes: The prize site calls ABH the Jack Ma Foundation's flagship philanthropic programme in Africa.

items.name: Africa Prize for Engineering Innovation
items.amount_note: 2027 prize: GBP 85,000 in total: GBP 50,000 overall winner, GBP 10,000 to each of three finalists, GBP 5,000 One-to-Watch (official news page).
items.deadline_text: annual: the 2027 prize call ran 13 July to 8 September 2026 (closed now)
items.stages: early commercialisation (eight-month commercialisation programme for the shortlisted)
items.eligibility: Engineers and innovators in sub-Saharan Africa. Two-stage application process. The how-to-apply page says applications are closed.
items.notes: Amounts from raeng.org.uk news item of 13 July 2026.

items.name: Cartier Women's Initiative

items.sectors: any sector with strong social and/or environmental impact
items.eligibility: Open to women-run and women-owned businesses from any country and sector that aim for a strong and sustainable social and/or environmental impact (homepage).
items.notes: Application page returned an error; amounts and window not verified.

items.name: Echoing Green Fellowship
items.kind: fellowship stipend (grant; recoverable grant for for-profits)
items.amount_note: Seed funding: a stipend over 18 months (100,000 USD). For-profit organizations receive it as recoverable grants (fellowship page).
items.deadline_text: annual: applications for the 2026 Fellowship are closed
items.regions: not stated on the pages fetched
items.eligibility: Applicants 18+ (by 1 June in the 2026 round), proficient in English, early-stage organization or idea that needs financial and non-financial resources. A company valued over USD 5 million, or earning over USD 2 million revenue with net profit, is not eligible (2026 page).

items.name: Google for Startups Accelerator: Africa
items.amount_note: No cash stated. Equity-free support for the duration of the three-month programme; Cloud credits can be applied for separately, subject to review.
items.deadline_text: annual: applications ran 4 February to 18 March 2026 (closed); register interest for the next one
items.eligibility: Cohorts of 10 to 15 startups. Read the eligibility section on the program page.

items.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
items.amount_note: Up to USD 350,000 in Cloud credits over two years (program page).
items.regions: not restricted on the page fetched
items.eligibility: Apply through the program page; eligibility rules are on the page.

items.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub

items.name: Orange Corners Nigeria (incubation programme)
items.funder: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Lagos, implemented by FATE Foundation
items.amount_note: Not stated on the Nigeria page; any innovation-fund support is described elsewhere and was not verified.

items.eligibility: Aspiring entrepreneur with core operations in Lagos, aged 18 to 35, with a validated innovative concept no more than 2 years old.

items.name: TEF Entrepreneurship Programme
items.amount_note: US$5,000 non-refundable seed capital per selected participant, as stated on the programme page.
items.deadline_text: annual: portal opens 1 January, closes 1 March at midnight (per the programme page)
items.regions: Africa (all 54 countries per the foundation's homepage)
items.stages: business idea, or business no older than 5 years
items.eligibility: Africans aged 18 or over, with a business idea or a business no more than 5 years old. Applications go through the TEFConnect platform. Other criteria on the page; read it before applying.
items.notes: Window dates are the page's standing statement, not a 2027 announcement.

items.name: UNICEF Venture Fund
items.amount_note: Up to USD 100K equity-free for early-stage; up to USD 400K equity-free for growth-stage companies that graduated from the early-stage investment (page). Awarded in 2 to 3 tranches against an agreed work plan.
items.deadline_text: no deadline stated on the page; apply by Expression of Interest
items.regions: companies registered in a UNICEF programme country
items.sectors: open source frontier tech (the page lists Data Science and AI among tech areas)
items.stages: early stage; growth stage for graduates
items.eligibility: Private business, open source solution showing promising results, registered in a UNICEF programme country. Check the page for the country list.
items.notes: Whether Nigeria is on the programme-country list was not read from this page.

items.name: develoPPP Ventures
items.funder: German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ); applications handled by GIZ
items.amount_note: Up to EUR 100,000 of catalytic funding per start-up (the page states 100,000 euros). Matching-funds model: investment of at least the same amount must be raised in addition.
items.deadline_text: current call: 15 November to 31 December 2026 (Egypt, Kenya, Nigeria, Rwanda, South Africa, Tanzania)
items.regions: Nigeria, Egypt, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa, Tanzania (current call)
items.sectors: innovative business models with social and/or environmental impact (development relevance)
items.stages: early stage with initial revenues (proof of concept)
items.eligibility: Privately owned, profit-oriented start-up registered in the target country (or registering before the investment). Already generating initial revenues, high development relevance and scalability. Investors for the matching amount should be in advanced talks; matching funds received up to 6 months before applying can count.
items.notes: Not a pure grant: needs matching private capital.

data.disclaimer: Grant details change. Check the funder's own page before you apply: we show when each row was last checked and link to its source.
